claims.statement: New pull requests are opened through the open_pull_request tool rather than shell creation; it accepts owner, repo, head, base, title, body and optional draft/thread-resolution controls, returns created=True for a new PR and created=False for an existing open PR on the head branch.

open_pull_request resolves a participating person's fresh GitHub OAuth token for PR authorship and otherwise uses the GitHub App installation token as the bot; a missing user token raises GitHubUserAuthRequired.

Before creating a PR, open_pull_request preflights repository, base branch, and applicable same-owner head branch access and returns structured access, branch-visibility, or generic-preflight failures with GitHub response diagnostics.

open_pull_request is idempotent per head branch: after a 422 create response it looks up an existing open PR and returns it with created=False, allowing the agent to update it instead of duplicating it.
The requested draft flag is a default: RunConfig.draft_prs overrides it when configured before the create payload is posted.

open_pull_request appends plan and source references unless the body already has a References heading; Linear and GitHub source links require GitHub confirmation that the target repo is private, while Slack source links are allowed for Slack-originated runs.

After a new or existing PR result, open_pull_request best-effort records usage, thread metadata, a PullRequest registry record, and Slack code-channel context/resource/diff information; telemetry failures do not invalidate the GitHub PR.

PullRequestCreationGuardMiddleware wraps execute and background_execute calls and blocks shell PR-creation fallbacks including gh pr create, gh api or curl creation of /pulls, including supported nested shell commands up to a bounded depth, with a non-recoverable pr_creation_fallback_blocked error.
Hosted main-agent and delegated tool-call stacks install the PR creation guard while local runs omit it; the workflow push guard is installed for main agents and subagents.

WorkflowPushGuardMiddleware recognizes only conservative standalone git push origin refspecs, inspects the sandbox repository for .github/workflows changes, and forwards an eligible push unchanged when no workflow files changed.

Workflow push approval is keyed by a fingerprint that includes workflow diff and push identity. An approved fingerprint rewrites the push to an explicit head SHA refspec; otherwise the guard persists or reuses a pending approval and returns WorkflowPushApprovalRequired, so changed workflow content requires a new decision.

request_pr_review is a PR-review handoff: it parses a GitHub PR URL, resolves active Slack-thread and triggering identity context, delegates to the GitHub review trigger, and adds a dashboard review URL when available.

CI auto-fix candidates are completed check runs with failure, timed_out, or action_required conclusions, excluding Open SWE checks; inherited failure names on the base SHA are filtered and permission verification fails closed unless the requester has write, maintain, or admin access.

CI webhook helpers extract branch and head SHA across check_run, check_suite, workflow_run, and status payloads; baby-sit processes only completed events and matches active watches by head SHA or branch before evaluating them.

fetch_pr_comments_since_last_tag merges issue comments, inline review comments, and nonempty reviews chronologically; a first Open SWE mention returns full context, repeated mentions return items after the preceding mention, and configured handles reject prefix-only matches.
Workflow approval records are stored in per-thread workflow_push_approvals metadata with review, notification, and decision fields; only the 20 most recent records are persisted.
The workflow push guard posts a Slack approval request only when the record is not notified, then marks it notified after the Slack post call completes.

The workflow approval web API requires a session and same-origin mutation protection, checks thread access, records the session actor's approval or rejection, and dispatches an approval follow-up that retries the unchanged blocked push.

A PR opened with resolves_thread=True may resolve its agent thread: lifecycle updates resolve only when all tracked PRs are terminal and at least one tracked record has the flag; otherwise terminal PRs set attention_reason="prs_closed", while reopening clears automatic resolution or attention.

The expedited review path accepts only a small, readable diff, excluding test files from the changed-line limit, and pins a fingerprint over the displayed non-test diff so test-only changes preserve votes.
An expedited review requires a non-author writer to approve; it verifies the pinned fingerprint before submitting that person's GitHub review, and a draft can be marked ready only by its author.

Expedited merge readiness blocks draft, closed or merged, conflicting, pending/required-failing, missing-required-check, unresolved-review-thread, and changes-requested PRs; a merge uses a constrained GitHub App token when available and does not bypass branch protection.
